title.narrative: Communication and Visibility of EU Cooperation

description.narrative: The objective of this contract is to ensure and promote the visibility of EU cooperation programmes in ASEAN. Through strategic visibility and communication efforts, this action will enhance the image of the EU as a cooperation partner, and increase the knowledge of EU programmes, as well as their results and impact: highlighting the EU support to EU-ASEAN dialogue, sustainable use of peatland and haze mitigation, ASEAN regional integration and Indonesia trade-related assistance.

title.narrative: To enhance the image and awareness of the EU as a cooperation partner in the ASEAN and increase the knowledge of EU programmes and policies, as well as their results and impact: highlighting the EU support to EUASEAN dialogue, sustainable use of peat land and haze mitigation, ASEAN regional integration and Indonesia traderelated assistance (countrylevel intervention closely linked to the regional programme ARISE Plus supporting regional economic integration and trade in ASEAN).

description.narrative: To enhance the image and awareness of the EU as a cooperation partner in the ASEAN and increase the knowledge of EU programmes and policies, as well as their results and impact: highlighting the EU support to EUASEAN dialogue, sustainable use of peat land and haze mitigation, ASEAN regional integration and Indonesia traderelated assistance (countrylevel intervention closely linked to the regional programme ARISE Plus supporting regional economic integration and trade in ASEAN).The expected results are: i.Longterm and strategic communication and visibility approach to development cooperation is developed and implemented.ii.High quality communication and visibility events are organised.iii.High quality communication and visibility products are produced and launched.iv.Increased media engagement is established, with improved coverage across all types of media.v.The awareness of how EU development aid and cooperation benefits ASEAN is increased.
